newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian garbage man saves newborn from crusher.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian garbage man saves newborn from crusher.

text.p: A Sao Paulo garbage collector saved a newborn baby from almost certain death when he snatched it from the back of his truck just seconds before it would have been crushed, officials said on Friday.
A police spokesman said that on Thursday morning Lucio dos Santos Lima switched off the compacting mechanism of his garbage truck when he heard a whimpering sound from the hold.
Santos told police he found a 6.4 pound (2.9 kg) baby boy inside a plastic bag together with the remains of a bank check written out for the equivalent of $97.
Police inspectors traced the check to a nearby apartment building, where Celia dos Santos Pereira, a 25-year-old maid, was identified as the mother of the child.
Santos, the mother of a 3-year-old girl, told police she gave birth to the child shortly before dawn on Thursday.

Feeling incapable of keeping him on a monthly salary of $400, Santos said she hid the boy in a plastic shopping bag and abandoned him on a streetcorner four blocks from the apartment house in which she worked.
Police said Santos was charged with abandoning a newborn child and released on bail.
Officials at the hospital where the baby was being treated described his condition as healthy and normal.
